sum: Great Elm Group, Inc., an asset management company, engages in credit, real estate, specialty finance, and other alternative strategies businesses. The company operates through two segments: Alternative Credit and Real Estate. The Alternative Credit segment focuses on income generation and capital preservation through investment in debt and income-generating securities, direct lending, CLOs, and specialty finance businesses, including factoring, asset-based lending and healthcare. The Real Estate segment engages in service, and end-to-end real estate platform combining investment expertise and turnkey execution capabilities for IOS sector. It is also involved in business development and investment management activities, as well as construction and consulting business. The company was formerly known as Great Elm Capital Group, Inc. and changed its name to Great Elm Group, Inc. in December 2020. Great Elm Group, Inc. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida.
ceo: Mr. Jason W. Reese (CEO & Executive Chairman)
